subject: english
question: Convert to indirect speech: He said, “How long have you been waiting?”

options.text: He asked how long had I been waiting.
He said how long I was waiting.
He asked how long I have been waiting.
He asked how long I had been waiting.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He asked how long I had been waiting.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Question format:** The direct question "How long have you been waiting?"
